_NUMBER_UNIT_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)([a-zA-Z%]+)\s*$")


class Measurement(BaseModel):
    value: float
    unit: str

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _normalize_input(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        If a ``raw`` key is present, split it into ``value`` and ``unit``.
        This runs before any field validation.
        """
        if "raw" in data and isinstance(data["raw"], str):
            raw_str: str = data.pop("raw")
            match = _NUMBER_UNIT_RE.match(raw_str)
            if not match:
                raise ValueError(f"Unable to parse raw measurement: {raw_str!r}")
            number_part, unit_part = match.groups()
            data["value"] = float(number_part)
            data["unit"] = unit_part
        return data


def parse_measurement(data: dict) -> Measurement:
    """Parse a dictionary into a :class:`Measurement` instance."""
    return Measurement.model_validate(data)

    r"""^\s*
        (?P<number>[+-]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?)
        \s*
        (?P<unit>[a-zA-Z]+)
        \s*$""",
    re.VERBOSE,
)


class Measurement(BaseModel):
    value: float
    unit: str

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _normalize_raw(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Convert a ``raw`` string like ``\"12.5kg\"`` into ``value`` and ``unit``."""
        if "raw" in data and isinstance(data["raw"], str):
            raw = data.pop("raw")
            match = _NUMBER_UNIT_RE.match(raw)
            if not match:
                raise ValueError(f"Unable to parse raw measurement: {raw!r}")
            data["value"] = float(match.group("number"))
            data["unit"] = match.group("unit")
        return data


def parse_measurement(data: dict) -> Measurement:
    """Parse a dictionary into a :class:`Measurement` instance."""
    return Measurement.model_validate(data)
